_notes: Oracle IAM Identity Domains (formerly IDCS). Create the SPA as a 'Mobile Application' (public client, no secret),
grant types Authorization code + Refresh token, tick 'Allow non-HTTPS URLs' only for local http:// testing.
document's 'issuer' is the fixed string https://identity.oraclecloud.com/ -> skipIssuerCheck must be true
and strictDiscoveryDocumentValidation false. Verify the iss of a real token from your tenant.
Scopes are fully qualified: <primary audience of the resource app> + <scope>, e.g. https://api.k8sgateway.local/orders.
Roles: Oracle exposes groups/app roles via scopes (groups, approles) and the userinfo endpoint; a groups claim
inside the ACCESS token needs a custom claim - decode a real token and set rolesClaim accordingly.
